text:
Marta: kicking off canary deploy now (14:00 PT). 10% -> 15m smoke window. Please monitor health, latency, and error rates. Rollback criteria: error rate >0.1% or p95 > 600ms.
Devin: ack — watching metrics & dashboards. will post p50/p95 every 5m.
deploy-bot: Deploy started by Marta — canary 10% in us-west1. Logs: https://logs.redwood/company/deploy/2123456789
Liam: heads up — added fallback route to small-quantized-v2 if we see memory errors. I can flip it instantly.
Jen: I'm on tracing/logs and alert watch. set me as escalation for >5/min errors. :mag:
Devin: quick smoke commands for folks:

```
# health check
curl -sSf https://api.redwood-inference.prod/health | jq .status
# sample generate
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.prod/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"ping","max_tokens":8}' | jq .choices[0].text
```
Marta: perf targets: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 400ms. If p95 between 400-600ms, hold and investigate. If >600ms, prepare rollback.
Liam: noted. CLI ready: `redwood route set --to small-quantized-v2 --reason "canary fallback"` if needed.
Jen: seeing a tiny spike in token errors ~2m in (0.03%). digging into logs now — might be transient.
Devin: p95 = 370ms at 14:05, errors = 0.02% :thumbsup:
Marta: cool. holding at 10% until 14:15 then will consider 50% ramp if stable. Post any anomalies here.
deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 50% at 14:16 after manual approval by Marta.
Jen: real-time trace shows one short GC spike on a single host, not systemic. I cleared that node from pool.
Liam: fallback ready but not needed. Standby if Jen calls it.
Devin: after ramp p95 = 390ms, errors steady at 0.03%. No rate limit issues.
Marta: all checks green for me. Ramp to 100% starting now. Thanks team :tada: 
Marta: note for postmortem: add a quick note in the runbook about GC node eviction during canary — small ops tweak. https://confluence.redwood/inference/runbooks/canary-checks
